chengdu-to-shanghai.name: Chengdu ↔ Shanghai
chengdu-to-shanghai.approx_cost: Non-stop about 2 h 45 min from Chengdu Shuangliu (CTU) or Tianfu (TFU) to Shanghai Pudong (PVG) or Hongqiao (SHA); ~1,000 flights a week (June 2026); fares vary.

chengdu-to-shanghai-train.name: Chengdu ↔ Shanghai
chengdu-to-shanghai-train.approx_cost: High-speed rail Chengdu East → Shanghai Hongqiao: fastest G239 (08:16–18:22) 10 h 6 min; others up to ~15 h; 2nd class about CN¥721–992 (dynamic fares).

chongqing-to-shanghai.name: Chongqing ↔ Shanghai
chongqing-to-shanghai.approx_cost: Non-stop about 2.5 h; economy fares quoted from about CN¥200 to CN¥1,870 depending on date.

chongqing-to-shanghai-train.name: Chongqing ↔ Shanghai
chongqing-to-shanghai-train.approx_cost: High-speed rail about 9–14 h (2026 G-train example 12 h 23 min); 2nd class about CN¥840–953 in 2026 guides (dynamic fares).

shanghai-airport-transfer.name: Shanghai airports ↔ city centre
shanghai-airport-transfer.approx_cost: Airports to city centre. Pudong (PVG): Metro Line 2 from Pudong Airport T1&2 to People's Square ~CN¥7, about 1 h (cheapest); or Maglev PVG–Longyang Road CN¥50 one way (CN¥40 with a same-day air ticket; CN¥80 return within 7 days; VIP CN¥100), ~8 min, then Line 2 to the centre (~30–40 min more). Maglev first/last trains reported as 06:45–21:40 from Longyang Road and 07:02–21:42 from PVG (third-party guide; check on the day). Hongqiao (SHA): T2 station on Lines 2 and 10, T1 on Line 10; ~CN¥5–6 and 30–40 min to People's Square. The Maglev is excluded from the 2026 metro fare review.
